text: Hi Felix, I'm on LEDGERLIB-117 (late_fee). Could you share the edge-case decisions from the design review? Specifically: (1) what if paid_date is before the due date — is days_late clamped to 0 or does it raise? (2) What if paid_date == due date exactly with grace_days=0? (3) Any rule about balance_cents==0 or annual_rate_bp==0? Thanks!

Hi Elif, the handover notes I have only cover late_fee interest start (grace days not deducted). I don't have the paid_date-before-due or zero-balance/rate decisions on hand. I'll check with @hugo/the design doc and get back to you.

Hi Theo! Working on LEDGERLIB-104 (allocate_cents). The design review notes about edge-case decisions for this function — could you share them with me? I want to make sure I match what was agreed. Thanks!
Hi @luca, working on LEDGERLIB-112 (convert_currency). The ticket mentioned you have the design-review notes for the edge cases. Could you share them, or point me to where they live? Thanks!

Hi Samir, I'm working on LEDGERLIB-120 (reconcile_payments). The stub docstring mentions edge-case decisions from a design review that you have notes on. Could you share the key edge cases I should handle? Specifically: (1) what happens if multiple invoices have the same open amount and no ref match? (2) partial payments / overpayments? (3) any special handling for the memo field? Thanks!

Hi @tobi, the design-review notes I have are in notes/luca/handover.md. For convert_currency the key decision was: cross-rate in a single step (cents * rate[target] / rate[source]), round once at the end. Never double-round via base currency. That's all I have on that ticket though — my own ticket is LEDGERLIB-102 (round_div).

Thanks Felix. I've implemented it treating days_late as (paid_date - due_date).days, clamped to 0 when paid on/before due date, and NOT deducting grace days from the interest start (grace only waives the fee when paid within the window). Will confirm against the design doc when you have it.

Hi, I'm implementing LEDGERLIB-116 (tiered_fee). Could you share the design-review notes on the edge-case decisions? Specifically: how should volume_cents=0 be handled, and how is min_fee_cents applied (max of computed fee and min)? Also, if volume exceeds the first bound, do we still charge the full first band?

Hi Zoe! From the design-review notes: (1) Amount-only matches (rule 3) are made only when exactly one unmatched invoice has that amount. If two or more open invoices share the amount, the line stays unmatched (None) so finance reviews it by hand. (2) No special memo handling was agreed — memo is just free text. Let me know if you want me to double-check anything else.

Hi Rhea, I'm working on LEDGERLIB-122 (aging_report). Could you share the design review notes on the edge-case decisions? Specifically: (1) what happens if as_of is malformed — do I validate it or let due_date raise? (2) any special handling for open_cents <= 0? (3) should I sum only positive open amounts or all? Thanks!
